remote.description: The remote source hosting the repository.

owner.description: The owner of the repository containing the function.

repository.description: The name of the repository containing the function.

commit.description: The commit SHA of the repository containing the function.

input.description: A value provided as input to a function.

output.description: Expression to transform the task result into a valid function output. Receives: `input`, `output` (the raw FunctionOutput from the nested function).
